A '''vanguard''' was a [[Division/Legends|division]] of the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|droid]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|armies]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and later the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. It was larger than a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] but smaller than a [[Regiment/Legends|regiment]], composed of 1,232 [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] organized into eleven [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transport]] [[Company/Legends|companies]] in addition to support [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and eighteen [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]]. Vanguards were commanded by a [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|battle droid officer]] and were designed to break through heavy defenses.<ref name="TEGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vanguards were mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', which was written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
